_readme: Asset list for scripts/gen-art.mjs. Each image = style + prompt. 'refs' are ids of already-generated images sent as references (same character / same art style). 'budget' caps images generated before the script refuses (override with --over).
style: Game sprite for a cosy mobile survival game. Flat, chunky cartoon style with thick dark navy outlines (#1A2938), simple cel shading, rounded friendly shapes. Snowy winter palette: icy blues, soft whites and slate greys, with warm ember-orange (#DD5B1A) and amber (#F6B04A) accents. One subject only, centred, whole subject in frame with a little margin, seen from the front at a slight top-down angle. No text, no letters, no ground, no cast shadow, no background scenery: transparent background.
